## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It starts at Aquaventure Waterpark, Atlantis The Palm, Crescent Road.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Make a Burj Khalifa-sized splash at Aquaventure Waterpark in Dubai, and enjoy 17 sun-kissed hectares of the world's most extreme waterslides and adrenaline-pumping river rides. Additionally, relax on a pristine stretch of white sandy beach where you can kick up your feet, sip on a cold drink, and chill out in the cool sea breeze. Cannonballs away!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €83.35. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 113 ratings and 45 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
